title: Generic resource graph wave 2 umbrella
goal: Maintain and prove an umbrella completion contract for generic resource graph wave 2, coordinating ordered phase families without weakening fail-closed semantics: wave 2 refusal/evidence baseline, append/writable file frontier, pipes/stdio graduation, generic-primary migration, stateful/read-only service envelopes, and runtime/app-specific envelopes. The umbrella is complete only when each family has a durable child-goal or retained proof evidence showing supported shapes, refused shapes, docs/coverage, local and remote validation where required, and explicit non-claims. It must not claim arbitrary process restore, any-binary movement, source-ISA emulation, runtime-profile restore, or support for unmodeled resources.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove the wave 2 fail-closed baseline child goal is complete or otherwise has retained evidence that writable fds, Unix socket subtypes, anon inodes, locks, mmap, inotify, and fanotify are classified and refused with exact evidence before target launch.
proofChecklist.evidence: Child goal .pi/goals/generic-stateful-io-wave2-baseline.json is COMPLETE with 12/12 proven rows. It proves distinct append/non-append writable-fd refusal, Unix socket subtype refusal, anon-inode/eventfd/epoll/timerfd/inotify classification/refusal, runtime file-lock evidence attempts with harness limitation, mmap/inotify/fanotify refusal, no accidental support graduation, local retained matrix /tmp/machinen-move-matrix-272-1781259834, remote amd64 retained artifacts /tmp/remote-wave2-baseline-matrix-1781260223 and /tmp/machinen-move-matrix-84591-1781260223, docs/coverage, focused tests, and final validation.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove the append/writable file frontier is represented by ordered child goals: first exact refusal for writable and append candidates, then append-only log continuation only after an exact contract and retained support/refusal matrix evidence exist.
proofChecklist.evidence: Append/writable frontier is represented by ordered child-goal evidence. stopIf: The umbrella would need to claim arbitrary process, VM, ELF, runtime-level, metadata-only, sidecar replay, app-exported-state, checkpoint-hook, source-ISA-emulation, any-binary, or broad runtime/process restore support.
A phase family lacks a child goal, retained artifact, or explicit remaining-work classification but would still be described as complete or supported.
A resource shape cannot be reconstructed or refused target-natively with exact captured evidence before target loader launch.
Bespoke/app-specific envelope priority would be weakened during the migration period without an explicit proven migration contract.
Remote amd64 proof is required for a support claim but is missing or failed for an infrastructure reason that cannot be narrowly classified with retained artifacts.
Coverage, docs, inventory, matrix rows, or migration mappings drift and cannot be reconciled in the same goal run.
Validation commands required by the contract cannot be run or cannot pass after a reasonable fix attempt.
The /goal loop reaches 8 agent completion(s) without satisfying the contract.

A dedicated append-only log continuation child goal should be created or completed before the umbrella can claim that phase family complete. Umbrella inventory/docs and final umbrella validation remain pending.
